$comment: Opt-in release policy read by skills/bump-version/scripts/release-check.mjs (PR/MR skills, PreToolUse hook, CI). Paths outside userFacing (README, CLAUDE.md, .claude, .github, .husky, .vscode, evals, package files) never require a changelog entry or version bump. Add an exempt entry, with a reason, for anything inside userFacing that does not ship to users. versionReset ({version, reason}) lets the check accept one deliberate downgrade below the target version; it does nothing once merged.

versionReset.reason: Restart pre-1.0: the plugin still changes often; 1.x–3.x were never tagged.
